results.name: Files ▸ Remove metadata (copy) on a host .docx; overwrite mode also forgets the version that still held the author
amnesic session: AMNESIC badge, files in RAM only, notes refused + logged, localStorage and IndexedDB leave no trace, /Private still persists
emergency shutdown chord: keys + RAM files gone, page blanked via location.replace (no history entry with the shell)
privacy headers: no-referrer, no DNS prefetch, nosniff, object-src none; API bodies are never written to the HTTP disk cache
no performance degradation: real AES-GCM throughput in the browser, and /Private saves vs host saves measured end-to-end
host audit in the UI: a plaintext file planted by another client is flagged and 'Encrypt it' seals it (name + content)
TT20 backup in the UI: download one encrypted file, verify it, wipe the host volume, restore it from the file — byte-identical ciphertext
TT20 amnesic unsaved-work guard: RAM-only files listed, leaving asks first, 'Keep all' moves them into /Private encrypted; emergency shutdown never asks
no page errors across the privacy flows
privacy fixture cleanup leaves no host nodes, versions or search rows for its owned paths
